27:1: Ta Sin. These are the verses of the Quran and a clear Book.
27:2: A guidance and good tidings for the believers.
27:3: Those who establish salah, give zakat, and they believe with certainty in the Hereafter.
27:4: Surely, those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have made their deeds fair-seeming to them, so they wander in confusion.
27:5: They are the ones for whom is the evil punishment, and in the Hereafter they are the greatest losers.
27:6: And surely, you receive the Quran from the presence of One All-Wise, All-Knowing.
27:7: When Moses said to his family: "Surely, I have seen a fire. I will bring you news from there, or I will bring you a flaming brand so that you may warm yourselves."
27:8: When he reached it, he was called: "Blessed is whoever is within the fire and whoever is around it. And glorified is Allah, the Rabb of the worlds.
27:9: O Moses! Surely I am Allah, the Exalted in Might, the All-Wise.
27:10: Cast down your staff. Then when he saw it moving like a snake, he turned back fleeing and did not return. O Moses, do not fear. Surely, as for Me, the messengers do not fear in My presence.
27:11: Except whoever does wrong and then replaces evil with good, then surely I am Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.
27:12: Put your hand into your bosom, it will come out pure white without harm, and go with nine signs to Pharaoh and his people; surely they are a corrupt people.
27:13: When Our signs came to them clearly, they said: 'This is clear magic.'
27:14: And they rejected them out of injustice and arrogance, while their souls were convinced of them. So see how the end of the corrupters was.
27:15: And certainly, We gave knowledge to David and Solomon. And they said: 'Praise be to Allah, Who has favored us over many of His believing servants.'
27:16: And Solomon became heir to David and said: 'O people, we have been taught the language of birds, and we have been given of everything. Surely this is a manifest bounty.'
27:17: And gathered for Solomon were his armies of the jinn, men, and birds, and they were marshaled in orderly ranks.
27:18: Until, when they came upon the valley of ants, an ant said: 'O ants, enter your dwellings lest Solomon and his armies crush you without realizing.'
27:19: Thereupon he smiled, laughing at its speech, and said: 'My Rabb, inspire me to give thanks for Your blessing which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents, and to do righteous deeds that will please You. And admit me by Your mercy among Your righteous servants.'
27:20: And he inspected the birds and said: 'Why do I not see the hoopoe, or has he become of the absent?'
27:21: 'I will surely punish him with a severe punishment or I will slaughter him, or he must bring me a clear authority.'
27:22: He did not stay long, then came and said: 'I have encompassed what you have not encompassed, and I have brought you certain news from Sheba.'
27:23: 'Surely I found a woman ruling over them. She has been given of everything, and she has a magnificent throne.'
27:24: 'I found her and her people prostrating to the sun instead of Allah. Satan has made their deeds pleasing to them and hindered them from the path, so they are not guided.'
27:25: 'So that they do not prostrate to Allah, Who brings forth what is hidden in the heavens and the earth, and knows what you conceal and what you disclose.'
27:26: Allah—there is no deity except Him, the Rabb of the Great Throne.
27:27: He said: 'We shall see whether you spoke the truth or have been of the liars.'
27:28: 'Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them, then turn away from them and see what they return with.'
27:29: She said: 'O chiefs! Surely an honorable letter has been delivered to me.'
27:30: 'Surely it is from Solomon, and surely it begins: In the name of Allah, the Rahman, the Rahim.'
27:31: 'Do not be arrogant toward me, and come to me as Muslims.'
27:32: She said: 'O chiefs! Give me your counsel concerning my affair. I do not decide a matter until you bear witness.'
27:33: They said: 'We are possessors of strength and possessors of great military might. The command belongs to you, so consider what you will command.'
27:34: She said: 'Surely kings, when they enter a town, ruin it and make the mighty of its people humble. And thus they do.'
27:35: 'And surely I will send them a gift and see with what the messengers return.'
27:36: So when they came to Solomon, he said: 'Do you help me with wealth? What Allah has given me is better than what He has given you. Rather, you rejoice in your gift.'
27:37: 'Return to them, for we will surely come to them with armies against which they have no power, and we will surely drive them out from there in disgrace, and they will be humbled.'
27:38: He said: 'O chiefs! Which of you will bring me her throne before they come to me as Muslims?'
27:39: An ifrit from among the jinn said: 'I will bring it to you before you rise from your place, and surely I am strong and trustworthy for it.'
27:40: The one who had knowledge of the Book said: 'I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you.' So when he saw it placed before him, he said: 'This is from the bounty of my Rabb to test me whether I will be grateful or ungrateful. And whoever is grateful, he is only grateful for his own soul. And whoever is ungrateful, then surely my Rabb is Self-Sufficient and Generous.'
27:41: He said: 'Disguise her throne for her; we will see whether she will be guided or will be of those who are not guided.'
27:42: So when she arrived, it was said: 'Is your throne like this?' She said: 'It is as if it were it. And we were given knowledge before this, and we had become Muslims.'
27:43: And that which she used to worship instead of Allah had prevented her, for she was of a disbelieving people.
27:44: It was said to her: 'Enter the palace.' When she saw it, she thought it was a pool of water and bared her legs. He said: 'Surely it is a palace paved smooth with glass.' She said: 'My Rabb, surely I have wronged myself, and I submit together with Solomon to Allah, the Rabb of the worlds.'
27:45: And certainly We sent to Thamud their brother Salih, [saying], 'Worship Allah.' Thereupon they became two factions quarreling.
27:46: He said: 'O my people! Why do you hasten the evil before the good? If only you would ask forgiveness of Allah, so that you might receive mercy.'
27:47: They said: 'We consider you and those with you an evil omen.' He said: 'Your omen is with Allah. Rather, you are a people being put to trial.'
27:48: And there were in the city nine persons who caused corruption in the land and did not set things right.
27:49: They said: 'Swear by Allah: we will surely attack him and his family by night, then we will say to his guardian: We did not witness the destruction of his family, and surely we are telling the truth.'
27:50: And they plotted a plot, and We plotted a plot, while they were not aware.
27:51: So see how was the end of their plot: We destroyed them and their people, all of them.
27:52: So these are their houses, fallen in ruin because of the wrong they did. Surely in that is a sign for a people who know.
27:53: And We saved those who believed and guarded against evil.
27:54: And We sent Lot, when he said to his people: Do you commit the obscenity while you see?
27:55: Do you approach men with lust instead of women? Rather, you are a people acting ignorantly.
27:56: The answer of his people was only that they said: Expel the family of Lot from your town, because they are people who want to purify themselves.
27:57: Thereupon We saved him and his family, except his wife; We decreed her to be of those who stayed behind.
27:58: And We rained upon them a rain. And how evil is the rain of those who were warned!
27:59: Say: Praise is to Allah, and peace be upon His servants whom He has chosen. Is Allah better or what they associate as partners?
27:60: Or the One Who created the heavens and the earth, and sent down for you water from the sky? With it We caused to grow beautiful gardens. It was not possible for you to grow their trees. Is there another god with Allah? Rather, they are a people who deviate from justice.
27:61: Or the One Who made the earth an abode, made rivers within it, placed mountains upon it, and put a barrier between the two seas? Is there another god with Allah? Rather, most of them do not know.
27:62: Or the One Who responds to the distressed one when he calls upon Him, removes the evil, and makes you successors of the earth? Is there another god with Allah? How little you reflect!
27:63: Or the One Who guides you in the darknesses of the land and the sea, and sends the winds as glad tidings before His mercy? Is there another god with Allah? Allah is exalted above what they associate as partners.
27:64: Or the One Who originates creation, then repeats it, and provides for you from the sky and the earth? Is there another god with Allah? Say: Bring your proof if you are truthful.
27:65: Say: No one in the heavens and the earth knows the unseen except Allah, and they do not know when they will be resurrected.
27:66: Nay, their knowledge regarding the Hereafter followed one after another. Nay, they are in doubt about it. Nay, they are blind to it.
27:67: And those who disbelieved say: When we and our fathers have become dust, will we really be brought forth?
27:68: By oath, this has been promised to us and our forefathers before; this is nothing but legends of the ancients.
27:69: Say: Travel in the earth and see how was the end of the criminals.
27:70: And do not grieve over them, and do not be in distress/tightness from what they plot.
27:71: And they say: When will this promise be, if you are truthful?
27:72: Say: 'Perhaps a part of that which you hasten is right behind you.'
27:73: And undoubtedly your Rabb is surely full of bounty towards mankind, but most of them do not give thanks.
27:74: And undoubtedly your Rabb surely knows what their chests conceal and what they declare.
27:75: And there is nothing hidden in the sky and the earth but it is in a clear book.
27:76: Undoubtedly this Qur'an relates to the Children of Israel most of that concerning which they differ.
27:77: And undoubtedly it is a guidance and a mercy for the believers.
27:78: Undoubtedly your Rabb will judge between them by His judgment. And He is the Mighty, the All-Knowing.
27:79: So put your trust in Allah; undoubtedly you are upon the clear truth.
27:80: Undoubtedly you cannot make the dead hear, nor can you make the deaf hear the call when they turn away in retreat.
27:81: You are not a guide of the blind from their straying. You can only make hear those who believe in Our verses; so they are Muslims.
27:82: And when the word falls upon them, We will bring forth for them a dabbe from the earth that will speak to them: Undoubtedly mankind did not believe with certainty in Our verses.
27:83: And on that Day, We will gather from every nation a group of those who denied Our verses, and they will be brought together.
27:84: Until when they arrived, He said: Did you deny My verses while you did not encompass them with knowledge, or what were you doing?
27:85: And because they did wrong, the word falls upon them, so they cannot speak.
27:86: Did they not see that We made the night that they may rest in it and the day illuminating? Undoubtedly in that are surely signs for a people who believe.
27:87: And on that Day the Sur will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens and in the earth will be terrified, except whom Allah wills, and all will come bowing down.
27:88: And you see the mountains, you think them solid, whereas they pass like the passing of clouds; this is the work of Allah Who makes everything sound. Undoubtedly He is aware of what you do.
27:89: Whoever comes with a good deed, for him there is better than it, and they will be safe from the terror of that Day.
27:90: Whoever comes with an evil deed, they will be cast on their faces into the Fire. Are you recompensed with other than what you used to do?
27:91: I have only been commanded to worship the Rabb of this city, Who made it sacred, and to Whom belongs everything. And I have been commanded to be of the Muslims.
27:92: And I have been commanded to recite the Qur'an. So whoever is guided, is only guided for his own soul. And whoever strays, say: 'I am only of the warners.'
27:93: And say: Praise is to Allah. He will show you His verses, and you will recognize them. And your Rabb is not unaware of what you do.
